learning_outcomes.text: Be able to implement numerical methods related to differential and integral calculus and to compare these approximate methods with analytical or exact methods.
Be able to work with basic engineering functions and, more generally, with any basic mathematical tool.
Be able to calculate primitives of elementary functions and solve exercises based on function integration, such as calculating areas and volumes.
Be able to calculate derivatives and partial derivatives, and solve problems whose main tool is derivation.
Know how to operate with real and complex numbers, and understand the need for the introduction of complex numbers.

syllabus_topics: Derivative of a function at a point. Geometric interpretation
Partial derivatives. Definition and geometric interpretation
Differentiability of scalar functions. Linear approximation
Calculation of double integrals: iterated integration and polar coordinates
Introduction to Maxima software. Graphics with Maxima
teaching_methods: Laboratory work with symbolic calculation software (Maxima)
assessment_rules: This course is being phased out. Please consult activities and assessment system in the virtual classroom.
